I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **ticket #4092**.

I found it in #north-random, which Dana is a member of. Ilse posted there on Oct 13 at 11:55 that IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room, and warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table because it resets the Polycom. I passed that warning on too.

Dana also sent me a DM guessing the ticket might end up as OPS-5546 next year. That was private, so I left it out of the channel reply. I didn't take any other action.
